summary: Legacy VB6 application with minimal modern coding conventions. Transition to C# requires adherence to modern naming, error handling, and security practices.

rules.rule: Use PascalCase for class and method names in C#.
Implement try-catch blocks for error handling.
examples: try { /* code */ } catch (Exception ex) { /* handle error */ }

lint_recommendations: Ensure all C# code follows the .NET naming conventions.
scaffold_templates: C# class templates for forms and data access layers.
